# The working life of Aganjú: from the myths to the modern trades
Every age hires the same gods; only the job titles change. **Aganjú** never stopped working.

Aganjú's myths are less numerous than those of Ọṣun or Ṣàngó, but they centre on a single theme: the earth as a living, burning body that carries human life without belonging to it.

The [pattern atlas](/patterns/) — which maps every flagship temple to the industries its archetype demonstrably resonates with, each match argued and open to challenge — seats this temple in **4 industries**. This file reads those seats the way they were earned: through the myths.
## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Aganjú
- **Pantheon:** Yoruba
- **Domain of influence:** Wilderness, Earth, Diaspora Volcano
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Energy & Natural World · Home & Lifestyle
- **Strongest seat:** Forestry, Conservation & Outdoor Industries
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 7 of 271
## The Myth at Work

**Son of Odùduwà and Ọbatalá.** In Yoruba cosmogony, Aganjú is born from the union of the royal ancestor Odùduwà and the white-cloth creator Ọbatalá.  The story makes him kin to both earthly kingship and heavenly craftsmanship, but his own domain remains the wild land that refuses cultivation. — that is not just a story. It is a business model, four thousand years early.

**Aggayú Solá Carries the World.** In Cuban Santería, Aggayú Solá is imagined as a giant so large that he wades through rivers and carries the earth itself.  When he possesses a devotee in ceremony, the person's gait becomes heavy and swaying, as if the ground beneath them has gained consciousness. — remember the shape of that act. You will see it again, wearing a logo.
## The Seats

Each of these is argued in the atlas with a weight and a why-line. What the atlas cannot fit in one line is the whole myth — so here is each seat with its story restored.

### Forestry, Conservation & Outdoor Industries

*Forestry, wildlife protection, and outdoor recreation. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The uninhabited wilderness; the volcano’s wild margin.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Thermal, Geothermal & Fire Energy

*Geothermal plants, combustion, and industrial heat. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

The why-line says it in one breath: *The volcano and the molten core beneath the mountain; his fire moves slowly through stone — geothermal power personified.* That is not a resemblance; it is the same act, performed in a newer building.

### Environmental & Climate Services

*Climate science, ecology, and sustainability consulting. (Sector: Energy & Natural World)*

*His mythology reads as ecological warning: the ground we build on is alive, slow, and capable of overwhelming any city.* — the atlas stops there, out of discipline. The myth keeps going: the function Aganjú performs in the stories is precisely the function this industry sells.

### Home, Hearth & Real Estate

*Property, home goods, and domestic services. (Sector: Home & Lifestyle)*

*The ground cities are built on is his living body — land, real estate's founding asset, with a will of its own.* Swap the costume and the sentence is indistinguishable from the myth. That is what a resonance seat means.

Read the myth again after the seats and it stops sounding ancient: Aganjú's myths are less numerous than those of Ọṣun or Ṣàngó, but they centre on a single theme: the earth as a living, burning body that carries human life without belonging to it. The age changed. The work did not.
## The Method, Stated Plainly

None of this is numerology. A seat exists only where the match can be argued from the deity's documented domains and deeds — weighted, published, and falsifiable. The full derivation, the weights, and the challenge process are public on the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/). If a seat in this file reads wrong, the atlas itself tells you how to prove it — and the correction becomes part of the record.
## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in forestry, conservation & outdoor industries, thermal, geothermal & fire energy, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/sites/aganju/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit. The story is the pitch; the seats are just where it already works.
